chapter: Gil Evans, Birth of the Cool and the Second Herd
title: Back to New York with Chubby Jackson
summary: In spring 1949 Mandel got a job in Chubby Jackson's swinging band at Bop City with Tiny Kahn.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So you went back to New York, say, early ‘49.

Yes, exactly, yeah around March or April, immediately got a job in Chubby Jackson's band up at Bop City with Tiny Kahn, you know a real swinging band. And that was, Woody was in-between bands at that time, he had broken up the Second Herd, the First Herd and hadn’t… wait a minute…
I’m wrong about that, he had the Second Herd in ‘47, ‘cause that’s when they made, “Four Brothers.”
